title: Fix Puzzle 2D Performance Regression (Round 3 — Dirty-Scope + Batched refresh-ui)
description: Puzzle 2D board used to be very performant at the `premigration` git tag; after the migration from the bespoke `puzzle/2d/react/index.tsx` renderer to the generic framework shell + Rust/WASM BoardHost pipeline, zoom and selection now take multiple seconds. Root-cause refactor per plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/puzzle-2d-used-to-piped-balloon.md: (1) restore rAF-coalesced rendering in framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx (no more synchronous renderFrame()/dispatch per raw pointer/wheel event), (2) stop hover setters from bumping content_scene_generation in mathematical/graph/port/directed/normal/rs/lib.rs, (3) stop puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs from re-stringifying the whole fixture 3x per action, (4) parallelize framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx refreshUi()'s sequential awaits, (5) add spatial partitioning to hit-testing in the graph engine.
summary:
Round 1 (rAF coalescing, parallelized refreshUi, fixture-JSON cache) trimmed the edges of the regression but it persisted. Live profiling (dev shell :6012, nakagin example, 180 nodes/179 edges) found the true dominant cost was NOT the WASM/Rust side (~30ms total) but a React full-shell refresh cascade (300-650ms per interaction) — AND three severe correctness bugs in puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs that compounded every action:

1. **Edge duplication (data corruption + perf)**: `sync_host_from_envelope`'s `parse_fixture_v1` always `clear_scene()`s then rebuilds the headless plugin-side BoardHost, so every edge looked "new" and got re-emitted as an `edgeCreate` event. `apply_host_events` then replayed those spurious events into `envelope.fixture.edges` on the *next* action, duplicating every edge once per action forever (confirmed: 179 -> 358 -> 537 -> 716 edges over 4 selects). This also made `puzzle2d_document_delta_ops` fall back to whole-document `ReplaceDocument` ops (342KB for a pure select) since the granular replay couldn't reproduce a duplicated array.
2. **Selection silently dropped**: `applyBoardEvents`'s `select` case only mutated `envelope.runtime`, never `self.host`; `apply_host_events`'s "trust `host.selection`" re-sync then overwrote the just-set selection with the stale pre-action value every time — every click's selection was reverted by the time the response reached the shell.
3. **Camera echo silently reverted**: `apply_host_events` epsilon-compared `host.camera` (still the pre-action value) against the fixture and blindly overwrote the fixture with it, discarding every plain `camera` board event (the live wheel-zoom echo) before it could commit.

Fixed all three at the source (discard parse-induced host events before the action's own handler runs; sync host selection after applying select events; remove the camera write-back entirely since every camera-moving action already writes the fixture directly) plus added a fixture-content generation cache so `sync_host_from_envelope`'s expensive `parse_fixture_v1` rebuild is skipped for the majority of actions (select/camera/tool) that never touch fixture content.

On the shell side (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx, ui-interpreter.tsx): fixed a double-refresh-cascade bug (`applyHostEffects` minted a new `session` object even when nothing changed, and a boot-refresh effect keyed on session *object identity* re-fired a second full `refreshUi`); added `onActionStable` (permanently-stable ref-indirected action dispatcher) and memoized `parsePanelState`; added `preserveJsonIdentity`/`mergeRecordPreservingIdentity` so `refreshUi` reuses unchanged window/panel/tool/engagement/measure object references instead of handing React a fresh object every action; added a memoized `InterpretedUiNode` (`React.memo`) in ui-interpreter.tsx so window/panel bodies only reconcile when their content actually changed.

Measured end-to-end in the dev shell: main-thread longtask per interaction dropped from 300-650ms (single click) / ~630ms (drag) to 54-220ms for select/drag/zoom, with zero edge/selection/camera corruption across repeated actions. Deferred the more invasive parts of the original plan (a generic dirty-scope protocol on ActionResult and a batched hash-conditional refresh-ui WIT call replacing ~12 sequential WASM calls with one) as follow-up — the correctness-bug fixes plus the identity-preservation approach already closed most of the gap without touching the WIT interface used by every plugin.

Added regression tests: puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs (repeated_actions_do_not_duplicate_edges, apply_board_events_select_persists_across_the_next_action, apply_board_events_camera_event_commits, select_action_emits_no_ops — all 36 tests in the crate pass); framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts (7 new tests for preserveJsonIdentity/mergeRecordPreservingIdentity — 114 tests pass, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure in spawnedWindowChromeForKind from a stale test fixture not touched by this ticket). framework/renderer/react lint clean.
